changes: Added centralized flow fact policies for review pass, finding, pass-only normalization, reviewRound ISO string, and express verification exemption; wired handlers/rendering/tests/docs to those policies.
usage: Run npm run test:process-fact-contract to inspect flow fact policy inventory; run koala validate or outcome semantics smoke to verify express-exempt output and required evidence coverage.
expectedOutcome: User sees flow fact policies printed with artifact and gate mapping, pass-only finding_add converted to review pass, reviewRound documented as ISO string, and express zero-intent rendered as an explicit express-exempt policy.
actualTranscript: process-fact-contract printed flow fact policy: pass-only-normalization -> finding_add:pass-only->review_pass_set, flow fact policy: review-round-iso-string, and flow fact policy: express-verification-policy -> express-exempt; koala validate reported Verification intent coverage: 12/13 covered (0 required missing).
outcomeDiff: No user-visible gap remains. Expected policy names, dispositions, artifacts, and gate consumers are visible through contract output, and express exemption is verified by smoke rather than reviewer prose.
limitations: Runtime/environment facts intentionally remain outside process-fact-registry and continue through runtime-fact-registry plus runtime contract checks.
pitfalls: Review caught two evidence freshness issues and one handler ordering bug: category validation must run before pass-only normalization so direct handler calls cannot bypass category guards.
